official_source_anchors.name: Codex changelog
official_source_anchors.claim: Codex app includes in-app browser, richer PR workflows, artifact viewer, memories where available, plugins, multiple terminals, and Windows tray support.

official_source_anchors.name: Codex CLI reference
official_source_anchors.claim: Codex CLI supports --model and config overrides such as model_reasoning_effort.

official_source_anchors.name: Codex Windows app
official_source_anchors.claim: PowerShell is a valid Windows app execution environment and WSL remains a separate selectable environment.

official_source_anchors.name: Codex Automations
official_source_anchors.claim: Automations can use plugins and skills, but prompts should be tested manually before recurring scheduling.

official_source_anchors.name: Codex Chronicle
official_source_anchors.claim: Chronicle is documented as a macOS research preview and is not promoted as Windows-live in V47.

official_source_anchors.name: GPT-5.4 model
official_source_anchors.claim: GPT-5.4 supports xhigh reasoning effort for agentic/professional workflows.
